Using the Interface Error Insight Screen

children: Using the Interface Error Insight Screen
You can use the Interface Error Insight Screen to research errors that you encounter during the data download/upload processes.
The following is discussed in this topic:
Open the Interface Error Insight Screen.
Use the Basic Criteria Fields (located on the Filter Pane) to indicate the values for your primary search:
Press the Filter Button. The system will display the resulting records in the List Pane.
The Interface History Insight Screen's List Pane displays the results from a query performed in the Filter Pane.
For more general information about the List Pane, see the topic
